systems.name: App Proxy (umbrel-lnbits-cln)
systems.command: OUT=$(docker inspect lnbits-cln_app_proxy_1 --format="{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "APP_HOST|APP_PORT"); if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "$OUT"; else echo Proxy not running; exit 1; fi

systems.name: Tor Hidden Services
systems.command: OUT=$(docker ps --filter name=tor_server --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" | head -20); if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "$OUT"; else echo Tor services not running; exit 1; fi

systems.name: DR Health Sweep
systems.command: FAIL=0; echo "=== Bitcoin ==="; B=$(docker inspect bitcoin-knots_app_1 --format='{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$B" = "healthy" ] || [ "$B" = "running" ]; then echo "$B"; else echo "${B:-DOWN}"; FAIL=1; fi; echo; echo "=== CLN ==="; C=$(docker inspect core-lightning_lightningd_1 --format='{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$C" = "healthy" ] || [ "$C" = "running" ]; then echo "$C"; else echo "${C:-DOWN}"; FAIL=1; fi; echo; echo "=== LNbits CLN ==="; N=$(docker inspect lnbits-cln_web_1 --format='{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$N" = "running" ]; then echo "$N"; else echo "${N:-DOWN}"; FAIL=1; fi; echo; echo "=== Disk ==="; D=$(df -h / | tail -1); if [ -n "$D" ]; then echo "$D"; else echo DOWN; FAIL=1; fi; [ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]

systems.name: Nostr Relay Process Health
systems.command: docker exec nostr-relay_relay_1 sh -c 'ls /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} sh -c "cat {} 2>/dev/null" | grep -E "^nostr-rs-relay$|^nostr_rs_relay$" | head -1' | grep -q nostr

systems.name: Nostr Relay Restart Count
systems.command: docker inspect nostr-relay_relay_1 --format='restarts={{.RestartCount}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} status={{.State.Status}}' | tee /tmp/_relay_inspect && grep -q 'status=running' /tmp/_relay_inspect

systems.name: Nostr Relay Recent Errors
systems.command: ERR=$(docker logs --since 15m nostr-relay_relay_1 2>&1 | grep -vE '^\s*$' | grep -E 'ERROR|FATAL|panic|jemalloc|Unsupported system page size' | tail -10); if [ -z "$ERR" ]; then echo no recent log matches; else echo "$ERR"; exit 1; fi

systems.name: Nostr Relay WebSocket (NIP-01)
systems.command:
python3 -c "import socket,ssl,base64,os;k=base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode();ctx=ssl.create_default_context();s=socket.create_connection(('nostr.janx.com',443),timeout=8);w=ctx.wrap_socket(s,server_hostname='nostr.janx.com');req=f'GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: nostr.janx.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: {k}
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13

';w.sendall(req.encode());r=w.recv(4096).decode(errors='replace');print(r.split(chr(13)+chr(10)+chr(13)+chr(10))[0]);assert '101 Switching Protocols' in r,'no 101 upgrade';w.close()"
